name: WF-415 — Contract Readiness & Document Automation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Contract Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const p=ctx.property??{}; const s=ctx.seller??{}; const u=ctx.underwriting??{}; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const purchasePrice=num(d.purchasePrice??d.offerAmount??u.recommendedMAO); const arv=num(d.arv??p.arv??u.arv); const protectedMAO=num(d.protectedMAO??u.protectedMAO??u.recommendedMAO); const assignmentFee=num(d.assignmentFee??u.assignmentFee); const signedSeller=Boolean(d.sellerSigned??d.sellerSignature?.verified??ctx.sellerSigned); const signedBuyer=Boolean(d.buyerSigned??d.buyerSignature?.verified??ctx.buyerSigned); const contractDocId=String(d.contractDocumentId??ctx.contractDocumentId??'').trim(); const assignmentDocId=String(d.assignmentDocumentId??ctx.assignmentDocumentId??'').trim(); const titleCompany=String(d.titleCompany??ctx.titleCompany??'').trim(); const sellerId=String(s.id??input.sellerId??'').trim(); const sellerIdentityVerified=Boolean(s.identityVerified??ctx.sellerIdentityVerified); const propertyIdentityVerified=Boolean(p.identityVerified??ctx.propertyIdentityVerified); const requiredFields={sellerId:!!sellerId,propertyId:!!input.propertyId,purchasePrice:purchasePrice!==null,contractDocument:!!contractDocId,sellerSignature:signedSeller,sellerIdentityVerified,buyerSignature:signedBuyer,propertyIdentityVerified}; const missing=Object.entries(requiredFields).filter(([,v])=>!v).map(([k])=>k); const flags=[]; if(protectedMAO!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&purchasePrice>protectedMAO)flags.push('purchase_price_above_protected_mao'); if(!titleCompany)flags.push('title_company_not_confirmed'); if(!assignmentDocId)flags.push('assignment_document_not_ready'); if(arv!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&purchasePrice>arv)flags.push('purchase_price_above_arv'); const readiness=missing.length===0&&flags.filter(x=>x==='purchase_price_above_protected_mao').length===0?'ready':'not_ready'; const nextAction=readiness==='ready'?'generate_or_route_for_execution':missing.includes('sellerSignature')?'obtain_seller_signature':missing.includes('contractDocument')?'generate_contract_document':missing.includes('sellerIdentityVerified')?'verify_seller_identity':missing.includes('propertyIdentityVerified')?'verify_property_identity':missing.includes('buyerSignature')?'obtain_buyer_signature':'resolve_contract_flags'; const confidence=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Object.values(requiredFields).filter(Boolean).length/Object.keys(requiredFields).length*100))); const idempotencyKey='wf415:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId; return [{json:{...input,contractReadiness:{status:readiness,requiredFields,missing,flags,nextAction,documents:{contractDocumentId:contractDocId||null,assignmentDocumentId:assignmentDocId||null,titleCompany:titleCompany||null},economics:{purchasePrice,arv,protectedMAO,assignmentFee},confidenceScore:confidence,automation:{canGenerateContract:missing.length<=2&&purchasePrice!==null,canRouteForSignature:!!contractDocId&&sellerIdentityVerified,canAdvanceToAssignment:signedSeller&&signedBuyer&&!!contractDocId}},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Contract readiness and document automation is deterministic scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM contract/document schema, e-signature provider, title/closing provider, and production API contracts. This workflow does not create or execute legally binding documents by itself.
